title: An archived segment is the log's records at its positions, or it is refused
note: Phase C. Each mutation removes one rule of agent_substrate/archive.py: the digest a segment was sealed under, the newline every record ends in, the count of its records, a blank line, the chain from its first link, its last hash, the root its records give, the checkpoint's tree and its reach, the continuity of an archive's segments (positions, frontiers, links, genesis), the profile a history declares, a restore that never overwrites, a seal of what verified, and the shapes of what a keeper hands over. tests/test_archive.py holds each with a forgery a keeper of the archive could make. AR23 to AR26 hold the archive to the log's authentication rule: no record of a history that requires authentication is handed back by either check, a first segment's pin is held to its first record, and a profile must be one a history declares.

mutations.name: AR1_bytes_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a segment's bytes are not compared with the digest it was sealed under

mutations.name: AR2_torn_tail_read
mutations.find:
if not data.endswith(b"\n"):
        raise ArchiveError(f"{seg.name}: its last line has no newline")
mutations.replace:
if not data.endswith(b"\n"):
        data = data + b"\n"
mutations.rationale: a last line torn off its newline is completed rather than refused

mutations.name: AR3_count_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a segment may hold fewer lines than the records it was sealed as

mutations.name: AR4_blank_line_read
mutations.rationale: a blank line where a record was is skipped

mutations.name: AR5_links_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a record out of sequence, unlinked or altered is read on

mutations.name: AR6_last_hash_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the last hash a segment was sealed with is never compared

mutations.name: AR7_root_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the root a segment states is never compared with the one its records give

mutations.name: AR8_checkpoint_not_checked
mutations.find: if not T.verify_consistency(end, size, end_root, bytes.fromhex(root),
mutations.replace: if False and not T.verify_consistency(end, size, end_root, bytes.fromhex(root),
mutations.rationale: a segment is accepted whatever tree the checkpoint commits to

mutations.name: AR9_coverage_not_stated
mutations.rationale: a checkpoint too old to cover the segment is reported as another tree, not as too old

mutations.name: AR10_gaps_not_checked
mutations.rationale: segments with a gap, an overlap or out of order are read as one archive

mutations.name: AR11_frontier_continuity
mutations.find: if list(seg.frontier) != [h.hex() for h in front]:
mutations.rationale: a segment's frontier is not held to the records before it

mutations.name: AR12_link_continuity
mutations.rationale: a segment's first link is not held to the record before it

mutations.name: AR13_genesis_unlinked
mutations.rationale: the first segment may link to a record before the first

mutations.name: AR14_profile_assumed
mutations.find: profile = rule(None, events, problems)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
mutations.rationale: the archive reports every history as one that requires no authentication

mutations.name: AR15_restore_overwrites
mutations.find: fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
mutations.replace: fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
mutations.rationale: a restore writes over a log that already exists

mutations.name: AR16_seal_unverified
mutations.find:
if not report.ok:
        raise ArchiveError("the log does not verify: "
mutations.replace:
if False:
        raise ArchiveError("the log does not verify: "
mutations.rationale: a log that does not verify is sealed as far as it reads

mutations.name: AR17_frontier_length
mutations.rationale: a frontier of the wrong length reaches the tree code

mutations.name: AR18_schema_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a manifest of another schema is read as this one

mutations.name: AR19_truth_value_count
mutations.find: if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
mutations.replace: if not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
mutations.rationale: true and false are read as 1 and 0

mutations.name: AR20_missing_bytes_raise
mutations.rationale: a segment whose bytes are missing escapes as a lookup error

mutations.name: AR21_bytes_type
mutations.find:
if not isinstance(data, bytes) or \
            hashlib.sha256(data)
mutations.rationale: a segment's bytes may be text

mutations.name: AR22_proof_shape
mutations.find: if not isinstance(proof, list) or not all(is_digest(h) for h in proof):
mutations.rationale: a proof that is not a list of digests escapes as a parse error

mutations.name: AR23_archive_hands_back_required
mutations.rationale: an archive of a history that requires authentication hands its records back unauthenticated

mutations.name: AR24_segment_hands_back_required
mutations.find: return events if profile == PROFILE_UNAUTHENTICATED_LEGACY else []
mutations.rationale: a segment of a history that requires authentication hands its records back unauthenticated

mutations.name: AR25_genesis_pin_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a first segment pinned as needing no authentication is believed against its own first record

mutations.name: AR26_any_profile
mutations.rationale: a profile no history declares is accepted, and read as one that requires authentication
